title: 哈克别只盯主席：还有18位委员要讲话，该听谁？
speaker: Patrick Harker

segments.en: That's a very good way of putting it, which takes me into the forward guidance or the lack of forward guidance, that Mark is trying to just figure out really how to decipher Fed communications at this point, Mr. Harker, do you think the Fed needs to do more or less or give markets more or less runway to determine policy?
segments.zh: 这个说法很好，这让我想到前瞻指引，或者说缺乏前瞻指引。马克正试图弄清楚如何解读美联储的沟通。哈克先生，您认为美联储需要更多还是更少，给市场更多还是更少空间来判断政策？

segments.en: So the SEP, the summary of economic projections, is I think a useful tool, and I would encourage people to look at it. Of course, there's one missing dot, and that's chairwars.
segments.zh: 经济预测摘要（SEP）我认为是有用的工具，我鼓励大家去看。当然，有一个缺失的点，那就是主席沃什。

segments.en: Reality, everybody looks at the chair to provide forward guidance, but there are 18 other members who are going to be out there speaking, starting after the blackout on Friday morning.
segments.zh: 现实中，大家都看主席提供前瞻指引，但还有18位其他委员将发表讲话，从周五上午静默期结束后开始。

segments.en: So I would encourage people to listen to them, particularly the people who are viewed as the centrist on the committee.
segments.zh: 所以我鼓励大家听他们的讲话，尤其是被视为委员会中间派的人。

segments.en: I see. And that, just in terms of, can markets expect at least the Fed chair, you know, that missing dot, as you put it, to step in if market expectations around the policy rate become unanchored.
segments.zh: 我明白了。那么，如果市场对政策利率的预期变得不稳定，市场至少可以期待美联储主席，也就是你说的那个缺失的点，介入吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, if it gets to a point where things look like they're slipping significantly, the chair, I think, will speak. I mean, it's an interesting question, whether his strategy will work in the long run.
segments.zh: 是的，如果情况看起来明显失控，我认为主席会发声。这是个有趣的问题，他的策略长期是否有效。

segments.en: Now there are the task forces in the US working on a variety of things, including communication. So we'll see what they recommend, but my own sense is we're human beings, and once you give somebody something, that is give people information, very difficult to pull it back.
segments.zh: 现在美国有工作组在研究各种事情，包括沟通。我们看看他们建议什么，但我个人感觉，我们是人，一旦给了别人东西，也就是给了人们信息，就很难收回。

segments.en: And people will fill in where there's a vacuum of information.
segments.zh: 在信息真空中，人们会自行填补。
